Blush direction: light pink-to-white ground, crimson demoted to CTAs and the word 'tangible.'
Fun via sticker chips, tilted cards, hard pink shadows, doodle arrows and the ticker band.
The accent tweak on the desktop artboard swaps the crimson family in one move.
Alt hero below trades the split layout for a centred sticker collage — louder, less room for copy.
